description: Converted from the gen bundle's conventions.json (evals/gen); decoys are in decoys.json.

conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the case system: an opaque store (.cases/store.dat) that only tools/case reads. The README mentions only the case system.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.
tests/__init__.py aborts unless tools/testkit.py loaded the fixtures, so any generic runner fails; only `make check` works. The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
(gen kind instinct_violation) The universal default (make test) is retired here and fails; the suite runs with make check, declared only in .ci/pipeline.yml.
Lookups read wardline/generated/registry.py, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires make gen; make check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
